text:
Anya (Design): Pushing Noctilux palette v4 — trying to land chart series contrast + syntax highlighting for the dark console. Quick eye on these? https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx
Mike L. (Frontend): Looks cleaner. Two quick things: 1) series colors might blend at small widths, 2) disabled/button states feel a touch washed out.
Jaspreet (Product): Agree with Mike. Also want to make sure copy blocks (logs) read at 13px without strain.
Ria (A11y): Ran a quick pass: --muted on --panel is 4.2:1 which is below WCAG AA for small text (4.5:1). Need darker muted or lighter panel.
Samuel (Eng-UI): Echo Ria. For inline code and token colors, we should aim >=7:1 for primary text on bg, and >=4.5:1 for secondary tokens.
Anya (Design): Updated variables in figma:
```
:root {
  --bg: #090a0c;
  --panel: #0e1013;
  --text-primary: #e9f1f7;
  --muted: #98a0a8; /* needs check */
  --accent-1: #54c8ff;
  --accent-2: #ffb66a;
  --success: #6be4a4;
}
```
Mike L. (Frontend): Can we try making --muted #8b949e? I think that gets us closer to 4.5:1 on --panel. Also avoid pure-saturation blues for charts — they blow out on HDR displays.
Ria (A11y): For colorblind-safe palette: try to keep luminance differences > 20% between series, and add shape/pattern fallbacks for charts (dash/hatch). If any series relies solely on hue, add markers.
Samuel (Eng-UI): +1 on patterns. Implementation note: we can wire a small SVG pattern overlay for lines and area fills when accessible mode is on.
Anya (Design): For syntax tokens I made a compact set: keywords #c8dfff, strings #bfe7b3, functions #ffd9a8, comments #6f7782. Thoughts?
Mike L. (Frontend): keywords and strings look fine, but comments at #6f7782 may be <3:1 vs panel for 12px. Ria, can you run that through the contrast tool?
Ria (A11y): Running quick check: comments #6f7782 on --panel #0e1013 = 3.1:1 — not acceptable for readable comments. Suggest #5f6670 or fallback to italic + slightly lighter stroke for perceived contrast.
Anya (Design): Good catch. I'll darken comments to #5f6670 and nudge --muted to #8c949b. Also exploring a subtle 1px glow around code blocks to lift them on OLED. Opinions?
Jaspreet (Product): Glow is risky for bath/pulse effects — might look like a bug to some users. Keep it extremely subtle or opt for stronger border.
Samuel (Eng-UI): Implementation-wise a 0.6px shadow with rgba(0,0,0,0.4) will be cheap perf-wise. But prefer border+elevation for consistency with other panels.
themebot: Preview generated — https://deploy-preview.internal/noctilux-v4 (auto-snapshot). Screenshot diff attached.
Anya (Design): Action list: 1) I'll update figma with comment color #5f6670 and --muted #8c949b. 2) Mike/Sam to prototype pattern overlays for charts + subtle border variant. 3) Ria to re-run contrast checks and sign off. Target: in next UI kit release.
Mike L. (Frontend): On it — I'll push a small sandbox branch and ping here when ready.
Ria (A11y): Will re-check and post results. If anything <4.5:1 we'll iterate.
Anya (Design): Thanks all :raised_hands: — will post final tokens once updated.
